title: Model card
description: A model or system card as a record: what the model is, what it is for and not for, the data it was built and tested on, how it performs across groups and conditions, its limits, and the links to the rest of the technical file. The same record renders a Hugging Face style card and a CycloneDX ML-BOM component, so the card an auditor reads is the card production produced.
$comment: AI Governance Engineer templates and schemas library, v1. CC BY 4.0 (attribution: Jorge García Aibar). x-evidences names the obligations a field or record helps evidence: an illustrative mapping, not a claim of conformity and not legal advice. https://aigovernanceengineer.com/resources/templates

$schema.description: The URI of this schema, so a record says what it claims to be.

name.description: Model or system name, as the registry and the card title use it.

version.description: Version the card describes (a semantic version, a date or a build id). One card per version.

registry_id.description: Registry id of the model or system (the id of its register entry), so the card files against it.

developer.description: Organisation that developed the model and answers for the card (the provider, for the EU AI Act).

contact.description: Contact for questions about the model: a role mailbox or a support page, not a person.

description.description: What the model is and does, in a paragraph.

license.description: Licence of the model weights or service, as an SPDX identifier where one exists (for example "apache-2.0").

languages.description: Natural languages the model handles (ISO 639-1 codes where possible).

base_model.description: The model it was fine-tuned or adapted from, if any.

model_type.description: Kind of model (for example "gradient-boosted trees" or "decoder-only transformer").

task.description: The task it performs (for example "binary classification" or "text generation").

architecture_family.description: Architecture family (for example "transformer" or "convolutional neural network").

learning_approach.description: Overall learning approach, with the CycloneDX model card values.

library.description: Main library or framework the model is built with.

tags.description: Free tags for search and grouping.

repository.description: Source repository or model hub page.

paper.description: Paper or technical report, if any.

intended_uses.description: Intended uses: the tasks and contexts the model is for.

downstream_use.description: How the model may be integrated into other systems or fine-tuned, and on what terms.

out_of_scope_uses.description: Uses the model is not for, including reasonably foreseeable misuse.

datasets.description: Datasets used to train, validate, test or fine-tune the model.

name.description: Dataset name or id (a dataset card id where one exists).

role.description: What the dataset was used for.

url.description: Link to the dataset or its data card.

description.description: Provenance, scope and known gaps, in a sentence or two.

training_data.description: Training data: sources, provenance, selection and known gaps.

preprocessing.description: Preprocessing, labelling and cleaning applied to the data.

training_procedure.description: Training procedure: methods, key design choices and the compute used.

evaluation_data.description: Testing data: what it is and why it represents the intended use.

metrics.description: Performance results, overall and by slice (group or condition).

value.description: Result, as text so units and precision are kept.

slice.description: Group or condition the result is for; empty for overall.

lower_bound.description: Lower bound of the confidence interval.

upper_bound.description: Upper bound of the confidence interval.

dataset.description: Dataset the result was measured on.

metrics_rationale.description: Why these metrics fit the intended purpose, and the thresholds they were held to.

fairness_assessments.description: Assessments of groups at risk: benefits, harms and the mitigation.

harms.description: Expected or observed harms to the group.

limitations.description: Known technical limitations, including conditions under which performance drops.

ethical_considerations.description: Risks to people and society, each with its mitigation.

human_oversight.description: Human oversight measures, including the technical measures that help people interpret the outputs.

explainability.description: What the system provides to explain its output.

output_interpretation.description: How to interpret the output and use it appropriately.

predetermined_changes.description: Changes to the model and its performance that were planned in advance, and how they are controlled.

compute_and_lifetime.description: Compute and hardware needed, expected lifetime, and maintenance and update measures.

logging.description: How logs are produced, collected, stored and read.

cybersecurity.description: Robustness and cybersecurity measures, and the attacks tested.

environmental.description: Environmental impact of training and operation.

energy_kwh.description: Known or estimated energy consumed in training, in kWh.

co2_emitted.description: Carbon emitted, with its unit and method (for example "120 kg CO2eq, location-based").

applicability.description: Which documentation duties the card is read against. Drives the coverage checklist.

high_risk.description: Part of a high-risk AI system under the EU AI Act (Art. 11 and Art. 13 apply).

gpai.description: A general-purpose AI model under the EU AI Act (Art. 53 applies).
For a general-purpose AI model: the Art. 53 documentation, by link.

technical_documentation.description: Technical documentation of the model for the AI Office and national authorities (Annex XI).

downstream_information.description: Information and documentation for downstream providers (Annex XII).

copyright_policy.description: Policy to comply with Union copyright law.

training_content_summary.description: Public summary of the content used for training, on the AI Office template.

links.description: The rest of the technical file, by link: the card is one part of it.

risk_management.description: Risk management record or risk register.

impact_assessment.description: Impact assessment (AIIA, DPIA addendum or FRIA).

post_market_monitoring.description: Post-market monitoring plan and performance evaluation.

declaration_of_conformity.description: EU declaration of conformity, where one exists.

aibom.description: The AIBOM the card is part of (for example a CycloneDX ML-BOM).

standards_applied.description: Harmonised standards or other specifications applied, in full or in part.

change_log.description: Relevant changes since the previous version of the card.

last_updated.description: When the card was last updated.

extensions.description: Organisation-specific fields. Validators ignore their content; keep evidence-bearing fields in the core record.
